rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's twenty-one builder trees go (a row of corals, ficus, jacarandas and magnolias along the back fences, three 3 m from the house fronts, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); six come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two grills, the open lot corner, and in yards 6-14 m from the houses.

trees.why: the east back yard with the adirondack chair and the kettle grill: a coral tree over both

the open lot corner inside the wrought-iron fence, 20 m from the walls: a torrey pine
the middle yard inside the same fence, 13.5 m from the house, 31 m from the pine
